evidence_integrity.method: Viewed each of the eight listed candidate PNGs with tools.view_image. Read the input and case JSON files, the reference scope, handoff text, and relevant static prototype text. A delegated read-only helper independently checked Get-FileHash SHA256 against both declared hashes. No other images were loaded.

observations: The Scribe MangaDex catalog has the filter popover open at the right, with the underlying five-column grid, 1/9 folio, and Browse dock selection still visible.
The nine short neutral tag labels fit inside their outlined controls; sorting, publication-status choices, reset, and the loaded-count action remain distinct and readable.
Relevance is inverse-selected, while the unsupported follow and rating choices are visibly muted. The white popover has a complete black outline without shadow, stipple, or a dimmed backdrop.

The case state identifies catalog / choices / catalog-filter, nine tag options, and no active tag selection. The existing mechanical checks were read as identity evidence, not used as a substitute for this visual inspection.
The settings screen keeps its fixed left navigation column, Categories inverse selection, right-side heading, and selected Settings dock item.
The four actual category counts are all zero and align at the right of separated rows; the Uncategorized row has no rename action.

New category is visibly disabled, and no enabled rename control or success state is offered. This agrees with the declared unavailable category capability rather than claiming that creation or renaming succeeded.
Case state confirms settings_section=categories and enabled=false for all four category detail records. No clipping or overlap affects the category names, counts, or disabled add action.
intentional_differences: Custom category creation/rename is unavailable in this candidate; actual category counts and disabled actions remain explicit.

observations: The source manager preserves a 400-pixel installed column, separate empty available/update column, back action, add/list actions, and the Browse dock. Installed sources have their own visible 1/3 folio for 25 records.
Rows truthfully say configured rather than connected. The right pane reports zero available and zero updates, with an empty state and add-source action.

The visible configured source rows lose their identifying suffix: the first ten read as the same Configured local fixture 0... prefix, and all use the same Co tile and configured subtitle. Distinct saved configurations cannot be identified from these rows; see P3R1-SUP23-1.

The metadata contains distinct names such as Configured local fixture 00 with a deliberately long source name and Configured local fixture 01 with a deliberately long source name. The problem is visible truncation, not missing stored records.
intentional_differences: All source rows are real saved loopback configurations. Unverified configurations are not marked connected.

observations: The book summary is open over a two-column detail page without a dock. The visible underlying description uses a serif face, first-line indentation, and generous line spacing consistent with the static Scribe prototype.

The summary contains the first long description segment, a separate 1/3 tag folio, source/update/local-size metadata, a close action, and a distinct 1/3 description folio. Case state identifies book 5:komga:series-000, 34 retained tags, and a 700-character first description segment.
All twelve visible summary tags are reduced to the same Actual t... prefix, so their identities are unavailable despite their metadata being retained; see P3R1-SUP23-2.

The four exposed background detail tags near the bottom are too narrow for Actual tag 00 through Actual tag 03. Their labels extend outside their boxes and overlap neighboring labels; see P3R1-SUP23-3.
The summary's description pagination strip extends below the outlined body and leaves the lower surface without a closed black frame; see P3R1-SUP23-4.

The summary shows its short final description segment and 3/3 description folio. Previous remains visible and the final-page next action is absent. The shorter content produces a visibly shorter panel than the first description page.

The tag pager independently remains at 1/3, and the source/update/local-size rows remain readable. Case state confirms the same book, summary_is_book=true, description page 3/3, a 40-character final segment, and 34 book tags.
The summary tag labels still collapse to Actual t..., and the exposed background detail tags still overlap their outlined boxes; see P3R1-SUP23-2 and P3R1-SUP23-3.

The panel side outlines end around y=739, but the description folio sits around y=774 on a white strip continuing to roughly y=807. That strip removes the lower side and bottom outline, leaving the floating surface visibly open; see P3R1-SUP23-4.

The short repeated fixture prose and its continuation were not treated as missing content merely because they differ from the design's sample description. Complete cross-page text continuity cannot be established without the unprovided middle page.

The bounded filter popover has a complete black outline, white surface, and no scrim or shadow. Its tag folio reads 2/3 with both previous and next available, and the loaded-result action remains visible below it.

The selected first chip uses inverse fill and an inclusion prefix, but its label is shortened to +Actual...; the other eleven labels all read Actual t.... The unique number for the selected Actual tag 12 cannot be read; see P3R1-SUP23-2.

The case JSON confirms 34 catalog tags and state=1 for tag:Actual tag 12, with an existing recorded next-page selection check. This proves which tag the capture represents without resolving the visible labeling defect.
The underlying source setup retains its real loopback address, masked credential, and unverified-connection status. No connected or authorization success is implied.
intentional_differences: A real visible cover failed and settled in backoff; the native placeholder is retained truthfully rather than painted over.

observations: The final tag page shows ten controls in two rows, a 3/3 folio, an available previous action, and a visibly disabled next action. Adventure and Mystery fit, and the loaded-count action stays inside the framed surface.

The selected Actual tag 24 and the other numbered tags lose their unique suffixes to +Actual... and Actual t.... The selected appearance is clear, but the selected tag identity is not; see P3R1-SUP23-2.
The case JSON confirms tag:Actual tag 24 is included and that the recorded navigation check reached page 3. The captured source remains truthfully unverified.
No defect was raised for actual source counts, loaded-result counts, or the declared settled cover failure. These data differences do not explain the tag-label truncation.
intentional_differences: A real visible cover failed and settled in backoff; the native placeholder is retained truthfully rather than painted over.

observations: The filter's first tag page shows twelve neutral outlined controls, 1/3, a disabled previous action, and an available next action. Sort and status sections remain separated and the loaded-count action is unobstructed.
Every visible numbered tag is elided to the same Actual t... prefix. A user cannot identify Actual tag 00 through Actual tag 11 before choosing a three-state filter; see P3R1-SUP23-2.
Case state retains all 34 actual tag options with no selection. The defect is not metadata truncation: it is the loss of the distinguishing part of each visible label.
The source header remains readable as Local Komga fixture. The setup page explicitly says the connection has not yet been verified, while unsupported follow/rating sorts are visibly disabled.
intentional_differences: A real visible cover failed and settled in backoff; the native placeholder is retained truthfully rather than painted over.

suggestions.description: Installed-source truncation removes the distinguishing suffix from multiple adjacent configurations.
evidence: At approximately x=100..337 on the first installed-source page, the first ten names all display the same Configured local fixture 0... prefix. Their Co tiles and configured subtitles are also identical.

The case state has distinct configured-00 and configured-01 records with names Configured local fixture 00 with a deliberately long source name and Configured local fixture 01 with a deliberately long source name, within 25 actual saved configurations.
suggestions.recommendation: Preserve a readable distinguishing portion of long source names within the 400-pixel column, using wrapping, more name allocation, or a truncation strategy that retains the unique suffix. Keep the configuration status visible and truthful.

suggestions.description: Numbered tag labels collapse to an indistinguishable prefix across the summary and all three filter pages.
evidence: filter-tags-first shows all twelve visible Actual tag 00..11 controls as Actual t... at approximately x=310..874, y=598..697.

filter-tag-page-2 shows the included Actual tag 12 as +Actual... and the remaining controls as Actual t.... filter-tag-page-3 repeats this for included Actual tag 24 and the other numbered tags, although Adventure and Mystery remain readable.
description-and-tags and description-last-page also reduce all twelve visible summary tag labels to Actual t.... The case JSON retains 34 tags, including the 32 distinct Actual tag 00..31 identities.
suggestions.recommendation: Size or wrap tag controls so each full short identity, including its numeric suffix and inclusion/exclusion indicator, remains readable. Use fewer columns or additional tag pages as needed rather than eliding every tag to the same prefix.

suggestions.description: The detail information column draws long tag labels outside their control boundaries and over adjacent labels.
evidence: In description-and-tags, the exposed background tag row near y=1066..1102 has four narrow outlined boxes, but Actual tag 00..03 text spreads beyond those boxes across approximately x=20..282.
description-last-page exposes the same overlapping row. The first label begins to the left of its own outline and neighboring labels collide despite each tag having an outlined control.
suggestions.recommendation: Measure tag text within its box, retain horizontal padding, and wrap the row or use additional rows within the information column. Keep every label inside its own outline and preserve its distinguishing text.

suggestions.description: The description pagination strip extends beyond the summary's visible outline, leaving the floating panel open at the bottom.
evidence: In description-last-page, the black side rules at approximately x=115 and x=814 stop near y=739, while the 3/3 description folio is drawn near y=774 on a white strip extending to roughly y=807. No bottom rule closes that surface.
description-and-tags shows the same unframed lower description-pagination region below its taller summary body.
HANDOFF.md section 3.4 and docs/DESIGN_HANDOFF.md lines 196..200 require bounded Scribe floating panels with black outlines and white surfaces; content-dependent height does not remove that outline.
suggestions.recommendation: Include the description pager and its padding in the panel's content height, reserve it inside the frame, and keep the side and bottom rules visible after all white pager backgrounds are drawn. Let the complete bounded panel shrink with the short final page.

coverage_gaps: This supplemental batch contains no independent reference PNGs. Only the eight listed candidates were loaded; the reference scope, handoff, and static prototype text supplied the visual contract.
The middle description page and summary tag pages 2/3 are not listed. Complete prose continuity and all summary tag membership cannot be visually established from these captures.
Only installed-source page 1/3 is supplied. The remaining configured-source pages were not visually reviewed.
Long detail titles are partly covered by the open summary, so their unobscured layout cannot be qualified by these two summary captures.
limitations: This is a fresh visual review of one eight-image supplemental batch, not a declaration that the complete round is clean.

No application, build, tests, validation suite, smoke test, or runtime probe was executed. Existing case checks were read as evidence, and file hashes were checked using the explicitly allowed read-only operation.

The screenshots use the desktop backend at a 930x1240 logical viewport. They cannot qualify physical e-ink behavior, touch interaction, sleep/wake, hardware capability operation, or a 512 MiB memory budget.

Real titles, counts, dates, source configuration records, and settled cover-failure state were accepted at the data level. They do not waive clipping, tag identity, overlap, or panel-outline requirements.
